questions.question: This sign means: "Goods vehicles prohibited".
questions.explanation: False. Pedal cycles prohibited (R219): cyclists may not proceed beyond the sign. ("Goods vehicles prohibited" is the meaning of R229.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R219 (p.13)

questions.question: Which foot pedals does an automatic car have? (Select all that apply.)
questions.explanation: An automatic car has a brake (9) and accelerator (10) pedal but no clutch.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: This sign warns of slippery conditions for the next ____.
questions.explanation: Slippery road (W333): sudden braking or harsh steering could cause a skid for the next 2 km.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W333 (p.30)

questions.question: Before starting an automatic car, which position should the gear lever be in?
questions.explanation: Ensure that the gear lever is in "P" or "N" position.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 4 (p.20)

questions.question: When you drive one of the permitted vehicles into the area marked by this sign, what is the maximum speed?
questions.explanation: Pedestrian priority (R5): permitted vehicles must drive carefully at a maximum speed of 15 km/h.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R5 (p.5)

questions.question: Passengers stand on the back of a goods vehicle. How high must the sides of the body be?
questions.explanation: Sides must be at least 900 mm high where persons stand.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.34 (p.26)

questions.question: You are driving on a narrow road and want to stop opposite a parked vehicle. The roadway is 7 m wide. Is this allowed?

options.text: Yes, if you switch on your hazard lights
No – you may not stop alongside or opposite another vehicle where the roadway is less than 9 m wide

questions.explanation: No stopping alongside or opposite another vehicle where the roadway is less than 9 m wide.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.48 (p.31)

questions.question: Who may give traffic control signals that you must obey? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: A police or traffic officer in uniform
A person leading or driving cattle on the road
A member of a scholar patrol

questions.explanation: Traffic control signals are directions given by uniformed police or traffic officers, scholar patrols, road workmen, persons leading animals, signalmen at level crossings and drivers of emergency vehicles sounding a device.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 33 (p.54)

questions.question: A red cross over a sign cancels the restriction shown on that sign.
questions.explanation: De-restriction signs (R600): from here you do not have to comply with the restriction sign with the same symbol.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.8 R600 (p.22)

questions.question: A person who is 65 years or older applies for a learner's licence. What extra document is required?

options.text: A letter from a family member
Proof of a driving school booking
An eye test only from an optometrist

questions.explanation: An applicant aged 65 or older must submit a medical certificate on form MC signed by a medical or occupational health practitioner.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.4 (p.14)

questions.question: Match each light to the minimum distance in the rules.

options.text: Main beam must show objects at
Dipped beam must show objects at
Stop lamps visible in daylight at

questions.explanation: Main beam 100 m; dipped beam 45 m; stop lamps 30 m; number plate 20 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.2 (p.16); NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.3 (p.16); NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.6 (p.17); NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.7 (p.17)

questions.question: You may drive on the shoulder only if persons and vehicles are clearly visible for at least ____.
questions.explanation: Shoulder use requires visibility of persons and vehicles of at least 150 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.39 (p.28)

questions.question: In this automatic-transmission car, what is control number 2?
questions.explanation: Control 2 is the window wiper.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: Put these steps for changing down a gear in an automatic car (manual selection) in the correct order.
questions.explanation: LMV Module 26.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 26 (p.47)

questions.question: When is the clutch disengaged completely during stopping?

options.text: As soon as you start braking
Just before the vehicle comes to a complete standstill

questions.explanation: Disengage the clutch completely just before the vehicle is brought to a complete standstill, without labouring or stalling the engine.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 11 (p.27)

questions.question: At a roundabout (traffic circle) you must yield to traffic from the right, unless signs or signals direct otherwise.
questions.explanation: Yield to traffic from the right and/or pedestrians, unless otherwise directed by road traffic signs or signals.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 45 (p.66); NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.46 (p.30)

questions.question: How often should a heavy-vehicle driver check the rear-view mirrors?
questions.explanation: Check rear-view mirrors approximately every 5–8 seconds, and on approach to any hazard.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Heavy Motor Vehicle manual, Module 5 (p.23)

questions.question: When stopping in traffic behind another vehicle, about how much clear space should you leave?
questions.explanation: Obtain/maintain clear space behind the vehicle ahead – approximately 4–5 metres.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 29 (p.50)

questions.question: In which situations may you overtake another vehicle on the left? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: When the vehicle is driving below the speed limit on a two-lane rural road
When a traffic officer directs you to
On a one-way road divided into traffic lanes
The vehicle is turning right or has signalled to turn right

questions.explanation: Passing on the left is allowed if the vehicle is turning right, on certain multi-lane urban roads, on one-way roads divided into lanes, or on a traffic officer's direction — never on the shoulder or verge.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.45 (p.29)

questions.question: By definition, who is a "driver"? (Select all that apply.)

options.text: A passenger in the front seat
A person who drives or attempts to drive any vehicle
A person who rides a pedal cycle
A person who leads a herd of animals

questions.explanation: "Driver" includes any person who drives or attempts to drive a vehicle, rides a pedal cycle, or leads draught, pack or saddle animals or herds/flocks.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.3)

questions.question: You may only carry a passenger on a motorcycle if its engine capacity exceeds…
questions.explanation: A passenger may not be carried unless the engine capacity exceeds 50 cm³ and the passenger is in a sidecar or astride on a pillion.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.50 (p.33)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Cyclists only (R111): the road or part of the road may be used by cyclists only.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R111 (p.6)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: 4-way stop: the vehicle that stopped first moves off first

questions.explanation: Yield at traffic circle (R2.2): yield to vehicles in the circle or that will cross their yield line before you cross yours; the driver who reaches the yield line first may proceed first.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R2.2 (p.5)

questions.question: In this manual-transmission car, what is control number 5?
questions.explanation: Control 5 is the indicator light switch.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: What is the breath alcohol limit for a professional driver?

options.text: Less than 0,02 mg per 1 000 ml of breath
Less than 0,10 mg per 1 000 ml of breath
Less than 0,05 mg per 1 000 ml of breath
Less than 0,24 mg per 1 000 ml of breath

questions.explanation: For a professional driver the breath alcohol limit is 0,10 mg per 1 000 ml of breath.
questions.manualRef: National Road Traffic Act 93 of 1996, s65(5)

questions.question: If you change your residential address, you must notify the authorities within ____.
questions.explanation: A change of address must be reported within 14 days.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.5 (p.14)

questions.question: You should look in the mirrors for as long as possible to be sure of the traffic behind you.
questions.explanation: Care should be taken not to look in the mirrors for too long a period.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 5 (p.21)

questions.question: What is the horn used for?

options.text: To alert other road users in order to avoid a collision
To see what is to the rear and sides of the vehicle
To advise other road users of your intention to turn or change direction

questions.explanation: The horn is used to alert other road users in order to avoid a collision.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Which colour warning light is used by an ambulance?
questions.explanation: Ambulances, rescue and emergency medical response vehicles use red warning lights.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.16 (p.20)

questions.question: Which sign cancels a restriction?
questions.explanation: De-restriction signs (R600) show a red cross over the sign whose restriction is cancelled.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.8 R600 (p.22)

questions.question: What must you do at this signal?

options.text: Yield to traffic from the left only
Stop, and proceed when it is safe (as at a stop sign)

questions.explanation: Flashing red signal: stop and carry on when it is safe, as at a stop sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §8 Traffic signals (p.56)

questions.question: You intend to take the FIRST exit from a roundabout (traffic circle). When must you signal left?

options.text: On the approach to the roundabout
You do not signal for the first exit

questions.explanation: If intending to take the first exit, activate the left signal on the approach to the roundabout; for later exits, signal left in good time before the exit.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 45 (p.66)

questions.question: You should avoid changing lanes within an intersection.
questions.explanation: Changing lanes within an intersection should be avoided.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 28 (p.49)

questions.question: What does this road marking indicate?

options.text: Channelising line (traffic in the same direction)

questions.explanation: Channelizing line (RM3): traffic moves in the same direction; do not cross the line.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM3 (p.48)

questions.question: This road marking means: "Block pedestrian crossing".
questions.explanation: False. Channelizing line (RM3): traffic moves in the same direction; do not cross the line. ("Block pedestrian crossing" is the meaning of RTM4.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM3 (p.48)

questions.question: In this manual-transmission car, what is control number 8?
questions.explanation: Control 8 is the clutch.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Danger of electrical shock (overhead power cables)

questions.explanation: Pedestrian crossing (W306): slow down; stop if a pedestrian is waiting; do not overtake vehicles stopped at the crossing.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W306 (p.27)

questions.question: In this automatic car, which control do you use to steer?
questions.explanation: Control 4 is the steering wheel.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10); NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: A dipped beam must be able to show a person or object at a distance of at least ____ ahead.
questions.explanation: The dipped beam must enable the driver to see any person, vehicle or substantial object at least 45 m ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.3 (p.16)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Multi-phase traffic signals: your signal may stay red while oncoming traffic gets green

questions.explanation: Countdown signs: IN2 (two bars) means about 200 m to the exit.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §6 IN2 (p.46)

questions.question: Who must make sure that all persons in a motor vehicle wear seatbelts?
questions.explanation: The driver of a motor vehicle shall ensure that all persons travelling in the vehicle wear a seatbelt.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.17.1 (p.21)

questions.question: What is the maximum overall length of an articulated vehicle?
questions.explanation: An articulated vehicle may not exceed 18,5 m.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.30 (p.24)

questions.question: Which meaning belongs to each regulatory sign? Match them.

options.text: Hitch-hiking prohibited (no picking up for 500 m)
Heavy vehicles may not overtake other heavy vehicles (500 m)

questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R215: Heavy vehicles may not overtake other heavy vehicles (500 m). Sign 2 is R213: U-turn prohibited. Sign 3 is R223: Motor cars prohibited. Sign 4 is R207: Hitch-hiking prohibited (no picking up for 500 m).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R215 (p.12), R213 (p.12), R223 (p.13), R207 (p.11)

questions.question: In this manual-transmission car, what is control number 9?
questions.explanation: Control 9 is the brake.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: Tap the centre rear-view mirror in this manual-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The centre rear-view mirror is control 1.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: How may you let the driver of a vehicle ahead (not in the left lane) know that you intend to overtake?

options.text: By driving very close behind it
By switching on your hazard lights

questions.explanation: You may make the driver aware that you intend to overtake by flashing the headlights.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.45 (p.29)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: Pay toll ahead (last chance to take the alternative route)

questions.explanation: Agricultural vehicles only (R130).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R130 (p.9)

questions.question: Pair each regulatory sign with its meaning.

options.text: Excessive noise prohibited (no hooting for 100 m)
Right turn prohibited (you may go straight or turn left)

questions.explanation: Sign 1 is R212: Right turn prohibited (you may go straight or turn left). Sign 2 is R238: Horses and riders prohibited. Sign 3 is R217: No stopping. Sign 4 is R206: Excessive noise prohibited (no hooting for 100 m).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs R212 (p.12), R238 (p.15), R217 (p.12), R206 (p.11)

questions.question: This sign means: "Exit direction sign (at the off-ramp)".
questions.explanation: Exit direction (GA3): as close as possible to the off-ramp; only leave if you are in the left lane.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §5.2 GA3 (p.42)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Goods vehicles prohibited (R229).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R229 (p.14)

questions.question: What must you do when you see a vehicle stopped at a pedestrian crossing in the lane next to you?

options.text: Do not pass the stopped vehicle

questions.explanation: Whenever any vehicle has stopped at a pedestrian crossing, the driver of any other vehicle may not pass it.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.53 (p.34)

questions.question: Which motorcycles may NOT be used on a freeway?

options.text: Motorcycles with an engine of 50 cm³ or less, or propelled by electrical power

questions.explanation: A motorcycle with an engine not exceeding 50 cm³ or propelled by electrical power may not be used on a freeway.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.56 (p.35)

questions.question: What is the left and right rear-view mirrors used for?

options.text: To see what is to the rear and sides of the vehicle
To engage or disengage a gear and to avoid stalling just before stopping
To clean the front windscreen (e.g. when driving in the rain)

questions.explanation: The left and right rear-view mirrors is used to see what is to the rear and sides of the vehicle.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Put these in the order you meet them on a road with a hidden stop street.

options.text: Stop sign R1 with stop line

questions.explanation: W302 warns of a stop sign ahead that cannot be seen in time; you then stop at the stop sign/line before entering the intersection.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W302 (p.26)

questions.question: What does the arrow marking in your lane mean at the intersection ahead?

options.text: You may only proceed in the direction of the arrow in your lane
It shows the direction of oncoming traffic

questions.explanation: Mandatory direction arrows (RM8): you may only proceed in the direction indicated by the arrow in your lane.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM8 (p.50)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead does not carry on straight – you must turn left or right

questions.explanation: T-junction chevron (W409): the road ahead does not carry on straight but merges with another road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W409 (p.34)

questions.question: For how long is a motor vehicle licence disc valid?
questions.explanation: A motor vehicle licence and licence disc are valid for 12 months.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.8 (p.15)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: 4-way stop: the vehicle that stopped first moves off first
Stop – but you may turn left without stopping if you yield to traffic

questions.explanation: One-way roadway (R4.1/4.2/4.3): a one-way carriageway lies in the direction of the arrow.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R4.3 (p.5)

questions.question: A vehicle being towed is carrying passengers. What is the maximum speed (unless it is a semi-trailer)?
questions.explanation: A towed vehicle conveying persons may not be towed above 30 km/h unless it is a semi-trailer.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.57 (p.36)

questions.question: You see this sign. Who has right of way in the circle if there are no other signs or markings?

options.text: Vehicles already within the traffic circle

questions.explanation: Traffic circle (W201): if there is no indication you have to give way to traffic approaching from the right; vehicles within a traffic circle have right of way.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W201 (p.25)

questions.question: Which picture shows the hand signal for: turning right?
questions.explanation: Turning right: extend the right arm horizontally from the shoulder with the palm of the hand to the front.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 8 (p.24)

questions.question: When intending to change direction, which controls are used?
questions.explanation: Mirrors (1, 3) and the indicator switch (5) are used when intending to change direction.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.11 Sample questions (p.15)

questions.question: What is the gear lever used for?

options.text: To see what is to the rear of the vehicle
To engage or disengage a gear and to avoid stalling just before stopping
To see what is to the rear and sides of the vehicle

questions.explanation: The gear lever is used to select a gear.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Road narrows from the right"?
questions.explanation: Road narrows (W329): from the right-hand side.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W329 (p.29)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Congestion ahead"?
questions.explanation: Congestion (W355): possibility of congested traffic.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W355 (p.32)

questions.question: Which control is used to change the direction of the vehicle?
questions.explanation: The steering wheel (4).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.6 Sample questions (p.11)

questions.question: Tap the indicator light switch in this automatic-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The indicator light switch is control 5.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: This sign means: "Single-carriageway freeway begins".
questions.explanation: Single-carriageway freeway begins (R402): all freeway rules apply from the sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.5 R402 (p.19)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this road marking?
questions.explanation: Mandatory direction arrows (RM8): you may only proceed in the direction of the arrow in your lane.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM8 (p.50)

questions.question: Which hand signal does a motorcyclist give to show an intention to stop or suddenly reduce speed?

options.text: Waving the left hand up and down
Right arm extended sideways with the forearm vertically upward and palm to the front
Right arm extended horizontally, palm forward

questions.explanation: MC Module 9: extend the right arm sideways from the shoulder, with forearm vertically upward and with palm and hand to the front.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Motor Cycles manual Part 1, Module 9 (p.26)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?
questions.explanation: Crosswinds (W349): strong winds could force your vehicle off course.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W349 (p.32)

questions.question: An overhead lane signal shows a steady red cross above your lane. What does it mean?

options.text: You may not drive in that lane
Change lanes to the left soon

questions.explanation: Steady red cross (S17): you shall not drive in the lane over which the cross is displayed; it might be open to traffic in the opposite direction.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §8 S17 (p.56)

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Reserved for authorised vehicles (e.g. diplomatic corps)

questions.explanation: Limited parking (R306-P): may be free or paid; the maximum time allowed is shown on the sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.4 R306-P (p.16)

questions.question: The tyres of a light motor vehicle must have a tread depth of at least ____.
questions.explanation: A light motor vehicle's tyres must show a clearly visible tread pattern of at least 1 mm depth across the breadth and circumference.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.61 (p.37)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Vehicles transporting dangerous substances only"?
questions.explanation: R126: the road or part of the road is set aside for vehicles conveying dangerous goods.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R126 (p.8)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?
questions.explanation: Road narrows from both sides (W328).
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W328 (p.29)

questions.question: In which direction is the first bend on the road indicated by this sign?
questions.explanation: Winding road: in the case of W209 the first curve is to the left.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W209 (p.25)

questions.question: This sign means: "One-way roadway to the right".
questions.explanation: False. Stop/yield sign (R1.2): if you go straight you must stop; when turning left you may proceed without stopping but must yield to all traffic close enough to be a hazard. ("One-way roadway to the right" is the meaning of R4.2.)
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.1 R1.2 (p.4)

questions.question: Which colours may front direction indicators show?
questions.explanation: Front indicators: white, yellow or amber; rear indicators: yellow, amber or red.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.42 (p.28)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Right turn prohibited (you may go straight or turn left)

questions.explanation: Right turn prohibited (R212): you may proceed straight or turn left.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.3 R212 (p.12)

questions.question: Outside an urban area, where may you NOT park?

options.text: Off the road in a lay-by
On any portion of the roadway, or with any part of the vehicle within 1 m of the edge of the roadway

questions.explanation: Outside an urban area you may not park on the roadway (excluding the shoulder) or with any part of the vehicle within 1 m of the edge of the roadway.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.47 (p.31)

questions.question: A code 1 learner's licence allows you to ride a motor quadrucycle on a public road.
questions.explanation: A code 1 learner's licence authorises riding a motorcycle; motor quadrucycles are not allowed to be ridden on a public road.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §5.1 (p.12)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Parking (vehicles under 3 500 kg GVM, no time limit, fee payable)"?
questions.explanation: Parking reservation (R305-P): parking for vehicles with a GVM of less than 3 500 kg; no time limit but a fee must be paid.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.4 R305-P (p.16)

questions.question: Tap the sign that means: "Sharp curve to the right".
questions.explanation: Sharp curve (W204/W205): slow down to take the curve safely.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.2 W204 (p.25)

questions.question: What does this sign indicate?

options.text: General warning: danger of some kind ahead

questions.explanation: General warning (W339): there is a danger of some kind ahead.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §4.3 W339 (p.30)

questions.question: What is the meaning of this sign?

options.text: Keep right (pass to the right of the obstruction)

questions.explanation: Keep right (R104): pass to the right of the obstruction.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R104 (p.6)

questions.question: Tap the brake in this automatic-transmission car.
questions.explanation: The brake is control 9.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: In this automatic-transmission car, what is control number 6?
questions.explanation: Control 6 is the gear lever.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.3–2.5 Light motor vehicle – automatic gearbox (p.9–10)

questions.question: A load projects 400 mm beyond the rear of your vehicle during the day. How must it be marked?

options.text: With a red flag of at least 300 mm × 300 mm

questions.explanation: A load projecting more than 300 mm to the rear (or 150 mm to the side) must be marked by a red flag (300 mm × 300 mm) by day and retro-reflectors at night.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.36 (p.27)

questions.question: What is a "sidewalk"?

options.text: The portion of a verge intended for the exclusive use of pedestrians
Any part of the road next to a parked car

questions.explanation: "Sidewalk" means that portion of a verge intended for the exclusive use of pedestrians.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – Acronyms and definitions (p.8)

questions.question: At a scholar patrol crossing, when may you proceed after stopping?

options.text: As soon as the children are off your half of the road
When the patrol waves you through, even if the sign is still shown
Only when the stop sign has been removed and it is safe

questions.explanation: At a scholar patrol crossing, only proceed when the stop sign has been removed and it is safe to do so.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS K53 Light Motor Vehicle (Code B) manual, Module 37 (p.58)

questions.question: A broken red line along the edge of the road means you may not stop during the times shown on a road sign.
questions.explanation: No stopping lines (RM12): in the case of a broken line, you may not stop during the times indicated by a road traffic sign.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §7.1 RM12 (p.51)

questions.question: Which number shows the accelerator in this manual-transmission car?
questions.explanation: The accelerator is number 10.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Vehicle Controls §2.1–2.2 Light motor vehicle – manual gearbox (p.8–9)

questions.question: A combination of motor vehicles may consist of a drawing vehicle and at most…

options.text: Any number of trailers if within 22 m
Two trailers, or one other motor vehicle that is not a trailer

questions.explanation: A combination is restricted to a drawing vehicle and a maximum of two trailers, or one other motor vehicle which is not a trailer.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.58 (p.36)

questions.question: Which sign means: "Pay toll ahead (last chance to take the alternative route)"?
questions.explanation: Pay toll (R132): your last opportunity to follow an alternative route, or proceed and pay the toll.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Road Traffic Signs §3.2 R132 (p.9)

questions.question: Deafness on its own disqualifies a person from obtaining a learner's licence.
questions.explanation: The manual states that deafness shall not of itself be deemed to be a disqualifying defect.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road – §4.1 Disqualification (p.12)

questions.question: A projecting load must be marked at night with retro-reflectors. Which colours are used?

options.text: Blue to the front and red to the rear
Red to the front and white to the rear
White to the front and red to the rear

questions.explanation: At night: white retro-reflectors to the front and red retro-reflectors to the rear.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.36 (p.27)

questions.question: A vehicle engaged in civil protection may use a warning light of which colour?
questions.explanation: A vehicle driven by a person engaged in civil protection uses a green warning light.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.16 (p.20)

questions.question: A vehicle left in the same place on a public road OUTSIDE an urban area is regarded as abandoned after…
questions.explanation: A vehicle left for more than 24 hours outside an urban area (7 days within) is deemed abandoned.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.54 (p.34)

questions.question: Stop lamps must be clearly visible in normal daylight from a distance of ____.
questions.explanation: Stop lamps must be visible in normal daylight at a distance of 30 m to a person of normal eyesight.
questions.manualRef: NaTIS Learner Driver Manual – Rules of the Road §6.6 (p.17)
